audits.title: TU6.8 An Audit of Day case surgery for cholecystectomy
audits.standard: British Association of Day Surgery (BADS) standard for day case cholecystectomy
audits.setting: Royal Oldham Hospital, trust-wide elective surgery

cycle1.result: Around 65% sent home the same day; 51 admitted, 33 pre-booked as inpatients (39% [13/33] with no specific reason). Performance 10% lower than the BADS standard. Mean length of stay 2.56 days (0–13).

audits.other_findings: 18 (35%) of the 51 admitted were booked as day cases; 8 had no documented reason for admission. Inpatient booking criteria recommended.
audits.citation: Gulnaz N, Akram F, Dixon M, Siddique K. TU6.8 An Audit of Day case surgery for cholecystectomy. British Journal of Surgery. 2022;109(Supplement_5). doi:10.1093/bjs/znac248.062.

audits.title: 980 Audit of the Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Pathway in Frimley Park Hospital
audits.standard: GIRFT: anticipated day case rate 90%, plus recommended technique (e.g. low pressure insufflation 10mmHg, no drains)
audits.setting: Frimley Park Hospital, elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy

cycle1.result: Day case rate 45% (58 of 107 stayed overnight); no surgeon documented pneumoperitoneum pressure.

audits.other_findings: 34% of overnight stays had no clinical indication, mostly patient preference or delayed recovery.
audits.citation: Oyekan O. 980 Audit of the Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Pathway in Frimley Park Hospital. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae163.286.

audits.title: BN SO11 - Optimising Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: A GIRFT-Based Audit and Efficiency Analysis
audits.standard: GIRFT national median day case rate of 60%
audits.setting: Elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy, day surgery unit, Northampton General Hospital

cycle1.result: Day case rate 64% (55/86), exceeding the national median of 60%.

audits.intervention: Business case to extend DSU recovery staffing and hours from 6pm to 9pm; coding team asked to separate elective from hot list cases.
audits.other_findings: Unplanned admissions mainly for observation monitoring (46%), late afternoon extubation (29%) and intra-operative concerns (18%); estimated cost over £12,000; GIRFT discrepancy due to inclusion of hot list cases.
audits.citation: MacDonald-Nethercott M, Jacob P, Tanner N, Finch G. BN SO11 - Optimising Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: A GIRFT-Based Audit and Efficiency Analysis. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_9). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae271.182.

audits.title: HPB SO65 - An audit of the day-case rate of laparoscopic cholecystectomies at a busy district general hospital and factors affecting this
audits.standard: Model Hospital target day-case rate of 75% for laparoscopic cholecystectomy
audits.setting: Croydon University Hospital, district general hospital

cycle1.result: 34% (29/85) were not day cases; causes included post-operative nausea or pain (11), monitoring (9), MRCP (3), social issues (3), bleeding (2), IV antibiotics (1).

audits.other_findings: Of the 29 non-day cases, 58% had afternoon operations, 48% Nassar grade >1 and 38% BMI >30; morning slots for high-risk patients suggested.
audits.citation: Stobiecka R, Dunstan M, Thomas R. HPB SO65 - An audit of the day-case rate of laparoscopic cholecystectomies at a busy district general hospital and factors affecting this. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_9). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae271.296.

audits.title: 211 Improving Compliance with GIRFT Guidelines: A Cross-Site Re-Audit of Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Across Frimley Health NHS Trust
audits.standard: GIRFT (September 2022) recommendations adapted into local guidelines: 90% day-case rate with standardised technique
audits.setting: Frimley Park and Wexham Park Hospitals, Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Day case rate 45% at Frimley Park.

audits.intervention: Updated GIRFT recommendations adapted into local trust guidelines.

cycle2.result: Day case rate 70% at Frimley Park (n=121) and 77.8% at Wexham Park (n=72).

audits.other_findings: Common causes of delay were pain (30%) and drain monitoring (28%); 14-day readmission 9% at both sites.
audits.citation: Jose E, Oyeniyi O, Rashid Q, Heinst S, Midya S, Wilson I. 211 Improving Compliance with GIRFT Guidelines: A Cross-Site Re-Audit of Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Across Frimley Health NHS Trust. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_10). doi:10.1093/bjs/znaf128.220.

audits.title: SP1.05 Optimizing Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: A GIRFT-Based closed loop audit
audits.standard: GIRFT day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomy rate (national median 60%)
audits.setting: Elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy, Northampton General Hospital NHS Trust
audits.intervention: Day surgery unit recovery hours extended to 9 PM; local anaesthetic protocol changed to include liver bed infiltration.
audits.other_findings: Main causes of unplanned admission were DSU closing at 6 PM, intraoperative concerns and pain; unplanned admissions cost about £12,000.
audits.citation: Kumaran N, Jacob R, Macdonald-Nethercott M, Venkatesan A, Tanner N, Finch G. SP1.05 Optimizing Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: A GIRFT-Based closed loop audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_13). doi:10.1093/bjs/znaf166.011.

audits.title: MTP1.14 Optimising Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: An Audit of Success Rates and Influencing Factors

cycle1.result: 64 (90.1%) booked as day cases, with day-case success rate 74.4%.

audits.other_findings: Success lower with age 60–79 (55.6%) and over 80 (33.3%) and with operations over 120 minutes; only 37% of failures were anticipated preoperatively.
audits.citation: Almoshantaf M, Devetzis K, Aboutaleb E, Othman Y. MTP1.14 Optimising Day Case Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: An Audit of Success Rates and Influencing Factors. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_13). doi:10.1093/bjs/znaf166.132.
